correctness.rationale: The critical hypothesis forces positive atomic mass, so the printed null-set conclusion is immediately impossible. Independently, the erased frame operator factors as S^{1/2}(I-theta_{u,u})S^{1/2}, with ||u||^2 equal to the atomic leverage. Positivity gives leverage at most one; rank-one spectral calculus gives invertibility exactly below one; and at equality S^{-1}F(omega_0) is an explicit nonzero kernel vector.
